messages:
maria: heads-up — after the strictness canary we started seeing a spike in tool-call schema rejections for fn_call hooks on the content-moderation model. Dashboard shows +3% at ~09:12 UTC.
kevin: weird, are those attributed to route or validator version? current events look like "validation" with no route label.
maria: yep that's the problem — the route metadata dropped in the validator rewrite (protobuf -> internal). I have a repro payload that triggers `INVALID_SHAPE`.
infra-bot: deploy: schema-validator v2 -> canary 10% (host pool a) :package_deploy:
jess: sampling note — we can't keep every failed payload. Proposal: sample 1/1000, store hashed prompt + redacted args. Legal ok with hashing as long as we keep raw out of logs.
kevin: telemetry fields we need: route_id, quota_bucket, validator_version, rejection_reason, tool_schema (name), fallback_used(boolean). Also add a "is_toolcall" flag so non-tool outputs don't mix.
maria: UX ask: console should have a "schema rejections" slice with quick bisection: filter by model, route, tenant, validator_version and show a sampled example (redacted) + exact schema diff.
jess: impl note: do NOT log full `tools` array. Log tool names + first 200 chars of `arguments` after PII redaction. Also include a compact diff blob: `{+missing_field: args.foo}`.
kevin: question — do rejections count against quotas? right now they count as request attempts which hurts customers when validator strictness vs adapter mismatch.
maria: for Hosted default we should NOT charge tokens for rejected toolcalls; for Dedicated we expose a per-tenant policy `count_rejects_against_quota: true|false` and let infra teams toggle.
jess: rollout plan: 1) Add route labels to validator telemetry (data-only) 2) Enable sampling + redaction 3) Feature flag `validator_strictness_v2` per-tenant and dry-run mode for 48h 4) Soft-block for 1 week 5) Hard-block behind opt-in.
kevin: dashboard/alert idea — golden-path success_rate = successful_toolcalls / total_toolcall_attempts (smoothed). Alert if delta > 1% from baseline or sudden drop in success_rate.
maria: filing datadog ticket + data request to SRE to increase retention for rejection samples to 7 days. I'll open RFC with action items. :thumbsup:
jess: I can take the sampling + redaction PR. tagging @kevin for telemetry schema, @sre-team for retention. anyone object to that plan?
kevin: :thumbsup: go ahead. I'll draft telemetry schema and sample event spec.
sre-team: noted — will review retention impact and adjust indices. Expect response in 24h.
maria: thanks all — will post RFC link here when ready.
